# Version 4.156.1 (Unreleased)
> **GPU rendering correctness**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.156.1 servicing release corrects Ganesh geometry and flush handling and Graphite clip-capacity accounting. These native fixes retain Skia m156 and do not change the managed API.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry** — Corrects matrix-axis mapping for rounded-rectangle radii and ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke widths. Transformed corner radii are clamped to half the device-space bounds to prevent overlapping corners. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
- **Ganesh empty-flush handling** — Keeps draw and flush tokens synchronized after an empty flush so atlas work from one flush is not treated as pending in a later flush. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
- **Graphite clip-stack capacity** — Accounts for clips still needing recording without double-counting recorded clips. A draw whose full effective clip stack cannot fit in a fresh pass is warned about and skipped rather than exceeding render-step capacity. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
